about_the_game:
THE LIGHT FADES. THE ABYSS AWAITS.

Descend into the depths of a dying ocean where the last remnants of light battle against an encroaching darkness. As a lone anglerfish guided by ancient relics and gifts left by the Guardians of the Deep, you alone can restore life to these corrupted waters—or witness their final descent into oblivion.

ILLUMINATE THE UNKNOWN

Navigate through haunting underwater landscapes where bioluminescence is both your weapon and salvation. Toggle your light to reveal hidden paths, solve intricate puzzles, and evade predators lurking in the darkness. But beware—sometimes, staying in shadow is the only way to survive.

DISCOVER ANCIENT POWERS

Uncover sacred relics and knowledge left by the Guardians of the Deep and master these gifts to overcome increasingly complex challenges as you venture deeper into the abyss.

A STORY TOLD IN SILENCE

No words are needed to understand the devastation that surrounds you. Through environmental storytelling and encounters, unravel the tragedy that befell these waters and perhaps discover your own origin.

FEATURES:

  • STRIKING MINIMALIST AESTHETIC - Experience a handcrafted visual style, where silhouettes and selective coloring create an atmosphere both beautiful and terrifying.

  • INNOVATIVE LIGHT MECHANICS - Use your bioluminescence to interact with the environment in unique ways, changing colors to affect different obstacles and creatures.

  • PHYSICS-BASED PUZZLES - Navigate a world where currents, pressure, and weight matter. Move objects, create paths, and manipulate your surroundings to progress.

  • ATMOSPHERIC SOUND DESIGN - Immerse yourself in a dynamic soundscape that reacts to your actions and the environment, enhancing the feeling of isolation and wonder.

  • ENVIRONMENTAL STORYTELLING - Piece together the history of this ruined world through visual cues, artifacts, and subtle details in the environment.

In Lumara, light is life, darkness is mystery, and the ocean holds secrets waiting to be discovered. Will you be its savior, or merely witness its final breath?

short_description: Descend into a corrupted abyss as a lone anglerfish in this atmospheric puzzle-adventure. Solve physics-based puzzles, uncover forgotten knowledge, face mutated creatures, and use your light to push back shadows and restore what was lost.
